controls.evidence: Superstate documents bridge() source burn and specified-amount delivery on supported EVM destination networks, plus bridgeToBookEntry. The shared issuer owner controls Ethereum/Plume token and ProxyAdmin contracts. Official documentation expressly states that the contracts are upgradable and all minting is gated by the Superstate Admin Address. The same issuer upgrade/mint reach can therefore replace or bypass a bridge supply ceiling; canRaiseCap is adverse raiseable semantics, not a protective fixed cap. Native subscription minting remains separately inventoried. No external validator, independent rate limit or timelock is established.
